HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

   B. Say Utsav from other faiths has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Utsav from other faiths with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
